rpc.usage.exportExtension: Save the usage export as a .{{format}} file.
rpc.protocol.mismatch: Protocol mismatch: the app speaks v{{app}}, the agent runtime v{{runtime}}. Reinstall AgentChainer.
rpc.claude.notFoundSeeGuide: Claude Code CLI not found. See docs/guides/AUTH_SETUP.md.
rpc.claude.noCliForPlugins: Claude Code CLI not found, so plugins can't be listed.
rpc.session.notRunning: This session isn't running. Resume it from the session list.
rpc.session.notAChat: Only a chat can do that; this session is a task's step on another agent.
rpc.session.runningAsStep: This session is running as a step of the task “{{task}}”. Open the task to follow it.
rpc.session.runningAsWorker: This session is a Team chat's worker. Open it from its Team chat.
rpc.session.closeTabBeforeDelete: Close this session's tab before you delete it.
rpc.session.endedMidTurn: The session ended before its turn finished.
rpc.team.needsBudget: A Team chat needs a budget cap for it and its workers.
rpc.permissions.linked: {{file}} is a link; AgentChainer doesn't write a workspace's settings through a link.
rpc.sdk.timedOut: Downloading the Claude Agent SDK timed out after {{seconds}} s. Check your connection and try again.
rpc.sdk.unreachable: Couldn't download the Claude Agent SDK (offline or blocked by a proxy?): {{reason}}
rpc.sdk.httpError: Downloading the Claude Agent SDK failed: HTTP {{status}}
rpc.sdk.integrity: The downloaded Claude Agent SDK failed its integrity check, so it was not loaded.
rpc.sdk.extractFailed: Extracting the Claude Agent SDK failed: {{detail}}
rpc.session.codexNoPlan: A Codex chat has no plan mode: choose Safe, Standard or Autonomous.
rpc.session.claudeOnly: Only a Claude chat can do that.
rpc.session.codexMissing: Codex isn't installed, or doesn't answer. Install it, or set its path in Settings.
rpc.session.agyMissing: The Antigravity CLI isn't installed, or doesn't answer. Install it, or set its path in Settings.
rpc.session.agyModes: An agy chat edits files (Standard) or only reads (Plan): it never asks first, so Safe and Autonomous aren't offered.
rpc.session.agyGone: This agy chat can't be continued: the app has restarted since, and agy keeps no list of its chats the app can read.
